1.text: Zaburi ya Dawidi.Uwiteka, ni nde uzaguma mu ihema ryawe?Ni nde uzatura ku musozi wawe wera?

2.text: Ni ugendera mu bitunganye agakora ibyo gukiranuka,Akavuga iby'ukuri nk'uko biri mu mutima we.

3.text: Utabeshyeresha abandi ururimi rwe,Ntagirire nabi mugenzi we,Ntashyushye inkuru y'umuturanyi we.

4.text: Mu maso ye umunyagisuzuguriro arahinyurwa,Ariko abatinya Uwiteka arabubaha.Icyo yarahiriye naho cyamugirira nabi ntiyivuguruza.

5.text: Ntaguriza ifeza kubona indamu zirenze urugero,Cyangwa ntiyemera ibiguzi ku utariho urubanza.Ugenza atyo ntabwo azanyeganyezwa.
